quiz.title: Tool Contracts, Errors, and Progressive Discovery

questions.question: Three tools named search, find, and lookup have nearly identical descriptions. What should be fixed first?
options: Keep the catalog but retry selection with examples of prior successful calls
Create distinct action, source, use-case, schema, and side-effect boundaries
Expose all three tools to every role so an agent can recover from a weak first choice
Use a stronger model to infer overlapping schema differences
questions.explanation: The catalog removed the information needed for selection. Distinct names, descriptions, negative uses, schemas, and authority boundaries repair the interface structurally.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B：明确action/source/use/schema/effect先修tool interface，不靠更强model或allrolesalltools弥补；实际服务ownership与auth另核。

questions.question: What should a structured authorization error communicate?
options: A request to switch models and repeat the call with more conservative arguments
A generic failure category plus an automatic retry delay that conceals policy details
Category, non-retryable state, safe message, and the proper approval or access next step
The internal stack trace and rejected identity claims so the agent can diagnose access
questions.explanation: Authorization will not change through blind retry. The harness needs a safe category and escalation action without internal or credential leakage.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C：authfailure明category/不可盲retry/安全message+正确grantapprovalnextstep；批准后可重新合法call，不永久拒所有情况或leakstack。

questions.question: When should an application force a structured output tool?
options: Whenever a conversation may eventually call a tool, so every response stays structured
When an action is authorized in the prompt but the client cannot inspect its arguments
When the model must both format a refund request and execute the transaction
When it needs a typed, validated record with no real-world side effect
questions.explanation: A schema-only tool can enforce the output contract. Real-world execution remains a separate authorized action and should not be forced merely to obtain JSON.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D：typedrecordnoeffect可schema-onlytool，native structuredoutput可选当前支持；tool_choice不force真实action/不能替参数审核。

questions.question: Why use progressive discovery for a large tool catalog?
options: It reduces context and selection load while preserving a small stable starting surface
It guarantees selected tools are safe because discovery occurs only after a model request
It keeps credentials out of integration code by loading them with descriptions
It makes undiscovered tools unreachable, so execution authorization is unnecessary
questions.explanation: Loading relevant capabilities on demand can improve context, selection, and cache behavior. Scoped discovery and execution authorization are still required.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A：渐进load可减context/选择负荷、stableprefix，但需同角色scope发现和执行auth，不能隐蔽工具即无风险。

questions.question: Where should a team store shared MCP server declarations and personal secret values?
options: Commit declarations and encrypted secret values together as one shared configuration
Shared safe declarations in project scope; secret values in environment or approved secret storage
Store secret references and resolved values in descriptions visible only to the host
Place declarations in project instructions and have each user provide secrets in prompts
questions.explanation: Project configuration supports versioned collaboration, while secret values must remain outside version control and be provisioned through a secure mechanism.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B：safe共享声明项目versioning，secretvalprotectedenv/approvedstorage，encrypted值仍secret且不prompt；这不授权安装sourceMCP。

questions.question: A static policy document is exposed as a tool called get_policy without side effects. Which MCP primitive may express the boundary more directly?
options: An agent-to-agent task assigned to a policy specialist with document access
An approval hook that injects the document after confirming the intended use
A resource exposing the policy as URI-addressed contextual data
A read-only tool because model-selected retrieval should always use the tools primitive
questions.explanation: A resource represents contextual data the host or model can read. Tools are best reserved for model-requested actions or computations.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C：staticpolicyURI contextualresource可直接表达读数据，host/调用表面还需授权与provenance；并非绝对所有静态数据禁止工具，按控制方向用途。

quiz.title: Claude Code Memory, Rules, Skills, and CI

questions.question: A root CLAUDE.md contains hundreds of lines that apply only to database migrations. What is the strongest improvement?
options: Move migration guidance to a scoped rule or Skill and keep the root file as a concise router
Keep the guidance in the root file but add a summary and stronger priority labels
Move every project instruction into separate Skills so the root file has no shared context or routing role
Copy the migration section into task prompts only when a developer remembers it is relevant
questions.explanation: Narrow guidance should load only in its true scope. A concise root file preserves high-value project context without making every task pay the full instruction cost.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A：migration-onlydetail移pathrule或Skill/root保conciserouter，而不是全部sharedconstraint移走或人工临时记得paste；actualscope/loader需现核。

questions.question: A PreToolUse command hook must block a tool and explain why. Which output contract is valid?
options: Exit 2 and print structured JSON to stdout so both blocking mechanisms apply
Exit 2 with stderr, or exit 0 with event-specific JSON
Exit 0 with plain text that asks Claude to deny the tool
Exit 1 and print a JSON decision to stderr
questions.explanation: Exit 2 is the blocking exit-code path; structured JSON is parsed only on exit 0. The two paths must not be combined, and each hook event has its own decision schema.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B选PreToolUse exit2stderr或exit0eventJSON是有效路径；其explanation“JSON仅0解析/不得并用”与15所读当前官方冲突，exit2合格JSON仍可读但allow不盖block，PRexit2更不能套Pre。

questions.question: What does allowed-tools in SKILL.md do?
options: Restricts Claude to exactly those tools until the session ends
Grants the listed tools permanently after the project folder is trusted
Pre-approves matching tools for one invocation turn
Overrides project deny rules for the Skill's bundled scripts
questions.explanation: allowed-tools is a temporary pre-approval, not a sandbox. Other tools remain available under normal permissions, and deny rules continue to apply.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C：当前14官方selectedconfirm allowed-tools在invocationturn预grant、nextmessage清，非限制池/永久grant/覆deny；workspace trust不必阻止其headless生效，所以安装前review不能省。

questions.question: How should a team configure a migration-auditor subagent that must stop cleanly when evidence is missing?
options: Use bypassPermissions in a worktree so missing access cannot interrupt the audit
Put its complete procedure in the root CLAUDE.md so every session sees the same prompt
Give it inherited tools and ask it to keep trying until it can report success

lessons.title: Reliable Extraction, Batch, and Independent Reviewers

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Learning Objectives
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 抽取criteria/schema/unknown/evidence四gate、有限retry/独立review与实时vsbatch，validJSON不证facts。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## The Problem
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 18%reject为原情境，臆造date/background义务/closestenum加盲retry只改善格式不truth，不当实测。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## The Concept
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 先judgmentdefinition再schema和repair/reviewer/dataset分母，raw/sourceversion保留。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Define the Judgment Before the Schema
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: party/action/trigger/deadline明确证据、unknownnull/other-review/否定例外，criteria一致才能annotate/grade同任务。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Use Few-Shot Examples for Boundaries
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: clear/near-miss/negation/missing/out-of-enum/multiobligation/conflict边界例比重复正例有价值。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Make Absence Representable
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: required+nullable可显式支持value或未知/缺失状态，schema不证明null正确；sourceknownabsence与unknown还需reason。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Use Tool Use for Typed Output
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: schema-onlyextractiontool无真实effect，toolchoice不是actionauthorization，currentconstrainedAPI支持另核。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Validate in Four Layers
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: syntax→shape→semantics→evidenceversion分层，语义/来源失败不无限JSONrepair。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Syntax
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: syntax只是parsedvalue，不当前pipeline任务成功。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Schema
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: schema校field/type/enums/bounds/required，不能authorityfacts。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Semantics
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: crossfielddeadline/effective、unsupportedcategoryreview等domain规则需trustedfacts。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Provenance
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: span支持exactclaim且belongs sourceversion，不source存在/子串词面就事实成立。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Feed Back the Smallest Useful Error
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 小fieldpath/category/cause/allowedaction反馈固定sourcepriorcandidate/attemptbudget，缺evidence转unresolved而不新猜。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Separate Generator and Reviewer
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: review拿source/candidate/rubric/findingIDs/field/evidence/disposition，fresh减correlation但humanlabels校precision-recall，不silentrewrite。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Choose Batch for the Workflow
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: dated50%/24h/noSLA只是July2026guide，currentpricing/compatibility未核不采数字；offline独立fitsbatch，interactiveadaptivefeedback realtime。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Make Batch Jobs Reconciliable
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: customID/source/schema/prompt/outputversion对unorderedresults/partial/duplicate/expiry/sourcechangedretry，数组位置不做join。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Evaluate the Error You Care About
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: fieldP/R/evidence-support/highriskfalsepositive/null/分类/disagreement/acceptedcostslice，均值不遮危险误提取。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Build It
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: Build It正文空；实际policy pipeline合同/40example/5passes/experiment/batch在Capstone后，代码只MDcheck。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Interactive Lab
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 实际20图uncertainty/criticality/cut55/45score选择accept/sample/quarantine，不实测4gate/falsepositivecost/reviewercoverage。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Practice Lab
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 将date改unsupported要实际semantic+evidencefindings/adjudication；词检测程序不会检查datevalue。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Shipped Artifact
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: MD声称40inputs/38success/2dependencyfail/指标98%和.014unit仅纸面无rawdata，不能原样作结果。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Verify It
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 7test只head/keywords/null/customID/datephrase/independent/placeholder，未执行任何generator/reviewer/batch或41source。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Capstone Connection
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: architectextractionscenario输入候选，需真实四gate+userauthorizedsource，原例未validatedsemanticpipeline。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Output Contract
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: policyID/date/region/action/threshold/span/sourceversion/reviewschema，nullable或other及reason字段需合同支持，不无界optional。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Dataset
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 40来源15clear10background5negation5missing5conflict为教学分布，真实代表性/风险与样本量另核。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Passes
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: generator→syntax/schema→semantic→independentreview→qualifiedadjudication每pass有typedstate和findings，前步过不保后步。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Experiment
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: zero/fewshot/reviewpipeline同source/cases/rubric版本比较falsepositive/support/cost/latency，未当前模型实验。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Batch Design
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: stableIDs/乱序/partialjob/dup/sourcechanged负例保completed并只重试safe项，无实际服务运行。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Use It
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: source原材料与normalizedoutput分离，criteria/schema变新outputversion/humancorrectionreason，不覆盖旧decision或隐瞒failure。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Exam Decision Patterns
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: validJSONwrongfacts补semantic/provenance，boundary不稳补criteria/near-miss，review批次按workflow/noeffect提取。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Common Traps
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 四trap格式真/forced值/无限repair/无findingsilentrewrite，分别unknownrepresentation/有限审核。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Schema Equals Truth
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: shape/types不证value在source或true。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Required Non-Nullable Fields
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 不可nullable会诱发臆造，required可以兼nullable并保未知reason。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Infinite Repair
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: semantic歧义反复guess不收敛，应budget终止保unresolved并qualifiedreview。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Reviewer Rewrites Silently
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: silentreviewcorrection丢哪个claim错及why，记录finding→controlledrevision/version关系。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Exercises
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 5exercise currencyrelationship/negativeobligation/humangoldreview/乱序stablejoin/acceptedcost，需要实际fixture或数据证据不原MD。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Key Terms
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: structure/semantics/provenance/nullable/batch/adjudication量义分开，qualifiedhuman判据不等多抽一次。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Further Reading
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: sourceGuide的pricing/limits和currentAPI兼容待核，原则与已有RAG/结构/评测主干去重，不复制认证specific限制表。

questions.question: An extraction pipeline always returns schema-valid JSON but invents missing dates. What is the primary gap?
options: A nullable absence state plus semantic and evidence validation
A discovery step that gives the model access to date-normalization tools
A stricter parser for invalid date formats
A larger extraction model that infers likely dates from surrounding document context
questions.explanation: The schema forces a value and checks only shape. Representing unknown explicitly and verifying claims against source evidence prevents validly formatted invention.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A：schema-valid臆造date缺nullable及semantic/evidencegate，parser/timeformat/更大model不能填真实不存在source；null还保reason/业务missing状态。

questions.question: Which few-shot example is most useful for reducing false-positive obligations?
options: Another clear obligation with new wording but the same straightforward boundary
A near-miss background statement labeled as not an obligation with the boundary explained
A longer contract excerpt containing several obligations but no labeled negative cases
A stylistically similar extraction example from another category with no boundary note
questions.explanation: Boundary examples teach the judgment that separates a plausible near miss from the target class. Repeating easy positives adds little information.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B：backgroundnear-miss负例及reason说明obligation定义，更多easy positives/长excerpt不定义判界。

questions.question: What should happen after repeated semantic validation failure on an ambiguous source?
options: Relax semantic validation for this record while keeping schema and evidence checks
Raise the reasoning budget for another bounded retry
Return an explicit unresolved state and escalate to qualified review
Select the most frequent candidate across bounded retries and mark it low confidence
questions.explanation: Bounded retry prevents cost and latency loops from converting ambiguity into confident fabrication. The source needs review or additional evidence.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C：反复语义失败保explicitunknown/qualifiedreview，不能放松gate或多vote猜测source事实。

questions.question: Why use stable custom IDs in batch processing?
options: They carry the authenticated user's tool authority into each asynchronous request
They ensure every request receives the same price and completion deadline
They let the model correlate nearby requests and improve consistency across the batch
Results may complete out of order and need reliable reconciliation
questions.explanation: Stable IDs join each result to source, version, and expected output regardless of completion order, retries, or partial job failure.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D：unordered/partial/retry按stablecustomID及versionsjoin，不carrytoolauthority或保证price/deadline，也不让batchmodel互联。

questions.question: When is real-time processing stronger than batch?
options: An interactive task whose model must call and observe external tools before continuing
A nightly reclassification whose results can be reconciled before the next day
A static extraction archive with no immediate user or downstream dependency
A large evaluation backfill of independent requests with stable custom identifiers
questions.explanation: Adaptive mid-request tool loops need immediate observations and continuation. Batch fits asynchronous, tool-independent work when the service window is acceptable.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A：interaction+adaptiveobserveexternaltool再continue要即时loop，offlinebackfill才可batch；具体服务API支持与SLA不从July指南永久推。

questions.question: What should an independent extraction reviewer receive?
options: The final category, confidence, and explanation without source text to avoid anchoring
Source, candidate record, evidence, and an explicit rubric in a fresh context
The source and final record without a rubric, allowing an independent standard to emerge
The generator's complete reasoning transcript so the reviewer can assess its intent
questions.explanation: Controlled inputs and a fresh context help the reviewer test evidence support and criteria without inheriting the generator's framing.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B：source/record/evidence/rubricfreshcontext减少generatorframing，但共同错gold仍相关，reviewer需independenthumanlabel校准不当truth。

lessons.title: Make Large Context Observable

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Learning Objectives
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: placement/retrieval/tooltrim/states/manifest-workingcontext/reviewstrata/provenance/contenttype分层，capacity不证明noticing或approval。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## The Problem
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 140files+docs+logs+4workers虽fit却securityburied/mostlypassed/18of24pretendfull/table结构损坏，failure为evidence/state非window上限。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## The Concept
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: context可靠是保存decisionstate/provenance/unknown与可核review，不更大prompt自动更好。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Context has an attention topology
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: goal/hardconstraints/taskgroupedIDs/决策question/仅关键invariants等placement候选，narrowretrieval需测实际模型/任务，不所有位置普遍最优。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Evidence needs an envelope
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: evidenceID/URI/version/type/effective/observed/authority/scope/extractor/location/status与body一起流，rawprose不够。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Trim tool output by decision value
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: trim删重复progress而保call/trace/querytarget/exit/errorretry/affectedIDs/failureexcerpt/countomitted/version/conflict/fullartifact，mostlypassed抹state。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Complete, partial, and blocked are first-class states
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: complete满足必要合同/partial保已valid+namedgap/blocked新authoritystate，model应用states非协议所有未来值closed枚举。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Escalate the reason, not the anxiety
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: missing/conflict/policy/permission/semanticrepeat/unknowneffect给具体source-owner/影响/期限/safenext，非modelunsure。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Large codebases need four different memory tools
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: manifest/scratchpad/subagent/compaction不同store/责任，需actualIDs/coverage而非文本称4memorytool。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Manifest
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: manifest外部持久scope/ownership/hash/status/findings/gaps为覆盖与恢复主记录。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Scratchpad
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: scratch只暂时hypothesis/查找/下一步，可弃但approval/operation不能solecopy。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Subagent
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: boundedworkerisolates concern，returnedsource/file/partial/cost需要coordinator验，不context隔离即facts independent。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Compaction
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: compactcurrentconstraints/verified/gaps/evidence/next减体量，不新durabletruth或验证freshness。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Confidence should be evidence-calibrated
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: supportclass/authority/freshness/coverage/knownagreement/novelty/consequence更可审，coverage及说92%不自动概率calibrated，需matchedlabels/error。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Human review should be stratified
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 所有高后果/partial/conflict/novel/threshold加ordinaryrandomsample能发现flagger漏类，reviewerdisagreement回评测而非vanityaccept率。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Content type changes meaning
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: Markdown/HTML/PDF/table/CSV/formula/code/image布局带关系，保originaltype/extractor/location/warnings且render实际核；文内指令untrusted。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Build It
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: Build It标题空；实际六步骤large-codebase review在Capstone段，main只文字packetchecker。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Interactive Lab
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 实际21图unsupportedclaims/consequence/cut线性选answer/retrieve/escalate，不埋/删/trimsource或算coverage状态。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Practice Lab
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 丢omittedcount/conflictowner会falsecomplete，需结构envelope+actualIDs；源删词验证不实际manifest。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Shipped Artifact
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 24filepartial与conflictpacket为预填纸面，sourceURI/hash/24/18和owner不是用户真实review。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Verify It
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 6tests核固定18of24/omitted/location/owner/safeaction/randomsample词，不computefullcoverage或render/概率校准。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Capstone Connection
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: architectappendix候选，真实steps需source/effect/permission与granularreceipt，原不证done。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Step 1: Create the manifest
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: manifest每in-scopefile/subsystem/owner/hash/type/state/assignee/finding/gap，deterministiccoverage核全IDs而不是总词。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Step 2: Define the context budget
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: budget goalconstraints/currentmanifest/relevantevidence/errors/output，fullrawlogs外存stableproof。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Step 3: Normalize tool results
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: search/test/fileadapters注入timeout/truncation/deny/partial须保scope/正确retry，不交通transporterror当toolfailure。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Step 4: Add escalation rules
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: policyconflict/uncoveredfile/permission/unknowneffectfixtures owner与safeaction，不能更多token代裁决。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Step 5: Calibrate review
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: severefinding/partial+randompassesreview对reportedclass/disposition/falseaccept路由，先定义risk与label。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Step 6: Test rendering
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: MD/tablePDF/CSV/sourcefile各原location/render语义核，scope仅练习，本次无PDF/图转换。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Use It
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: longcontext决策顺序salience/provenance/trim/states/escalation/evidenceclass/risk+randomreview不容量与confidence代全部。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Exam decision patterns
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 考试情境placement启发要保validauthority及currentversion，repeat少criticalconstraint不是双抄每rule。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Common traps
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: nine陷阱contextfit/noticing/summarysource/trimerrors/partialnegative/retryall/scratchDB/compacttruth/precise%/plainflatten逐层错。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Exercises
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 6exercise50pages/5000lines/300file/ownerpacket/10000review/render关系按实际evidence判据，数量是教学不是用户完成。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Key Terms
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: loss/provenance/states/manifest/scratch/compact/confidence/strata/type各词需explicitmeasurement对象，不把papercoverage当calibration。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Further Reading
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 2026-08-08引用官方longcontext/citations/modelwindow/SDK能力具体当前未核，stableevidence-trace与已主干去重。

quiz.title: Make Large Context Observable

questions.question: A critical policy fits inside a very long prompt but is repeatedly missed. What is the strongest first redesign?
options: Place the complete policy before the task, retain its original hierarchy, and rely on the context window to keep every rule available
Summarize the policy into a compact checklist, discard source metadata, and place that checklist immediately before the final decision
Split the policy into fixed overlapping chunks, retrieve the top-ranked chunks, and omit repeated constraints to reduce prompt redundancy
Place the task and hard constraints clearly, retrieve the relevant policy slice with metadata, and repeat only critical invariants near the decision
questions.explanation: Capacity does not guarantee reliable use. Clear placement and focused retrieval improve salience while preserving source identity.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D：task/criticalconstraints清楚，相关slice+metadata少关键invariants近决策，容量非有效利用；实际placement策略仍需同model/cases测。

questions.question: Which tool-result summary preserves the most useful recovery state?
options: Partial: 18 of 24 files reviewed, two finding IDs, six omitted files, retryable timeout category, trace ID, and full artifact reference
Partial: 18 of 24 files reviewed, six files omitted after a timeout, and the entire review should be restarted from the beginning
Complete: findings from 18 reviewed files returned, six files skipped after timeout, and a summary attached without trace or artifact references
Failed: 18 file results retained, six files left unresolved, and a retry offered without coverage details or inspectable finding references
questions.explanation: The structured partial result preserves coverage, valid work, error semantics, and inspectable evidence instead of erasing the gap.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A：18valid/6omitted+findingIDs/timeoutretry/trace/fullartifact保partialtruth，不能整suite重起浪费已读或把6unreviewed当noissue。

questions.question: What is the primary job of a large-codebase manifest?
options: A generated resolution of conflicting source claims
Durable coverage, ownership, version, finding, and unresolved-work state
A compact substitute for source files, tests, and artifacts
A temporary file map and session reading order
questions.explanation: A manifest is external authoritative workflow state. Scratchpads, context, and compaction serve different temporary or representational jobs.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B：manifest durablecoverage/ownership/version/finding/gaps，非conflict裁决/全文替代/临时readingorder，真实records与source可核。

questions.question: A connected policy source conflicts with another approved source and precedence is undefined. What should the agent do?
options: Retrieve both sources with a narrower query, compare relevance scores, and follow the higher-ranked passage for this case
Merge compatible statements, then apply the most recently updated wording wherever the approved sources still disagree
Preserve both sources and escalate the exact policy conflict to the owner
Prefer the narrower source as the more specific rule
questions.explanation: Undefined policy precedence is an authority gap. More generation or retry cannot safely resolve it.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C：undefinedapprovedpolicy precedence属authoritygap，保双方/範围/版本/准确矛盾给owner，不按relevance/newdate/narrowness自动制定规则。

questions.question: Which review policy best detects both known and unknown failure classes at scale?
options: Review stratified samples of the shortest and longest records, using input size as the proxy for easy and difficult cases
Review every record that fails a deterministic check or receives low model confidence, then accept the remaining population
Accept ordinary schema-valid results and review only records with explicit conflict, provenance, or incomplete-coverage metadata
Review high-impact, partial, conflicting, novel, and threshold cases plus a random sample of ordinary passes
questions.explanation: Risk strata focus attention on known hazards, while random sampling tests whether the flagging system itself is missing new failures.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D：highimpact/partial/conflict/novel/near-threshold+ordinaryrandomsample发现已知风险与flagger漏，实际N/权重/随机protocol需保存。

questions.question: Why should content type and extraction method remain attached to evidence?
options: Flattening can lose tables, footnotes, code structure, and rendered relationships needed to interpret the claim
They distinguish parser defects from source conflicts so every extraction failure can be retried without reopening the original artifact
They establish that a source is authoritative when the same extraction process can reproduce the cited text from the artifact
They allow semantic validation to reconstruct layout-dependent meaning without retaining the original rendered source for review
questions.explanation: Format carries meaning. Provenance must explain how the cited span was produced and where layout-dependent information may have changed.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A：format携语义，type+method+location帮助看到tables/footnotes/code被损，不能只元数据就复原layout或证明authority；需原asset/render回查。

lessons.title: Business Discovery, Requirements, and SLAs

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Learning Objectives
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: measurableproblem/requirementclasses/SLI-SLO-SLA/assumptionevidence/ownerbrief先技术，目标非已批准真实pilot。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## The Problem
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: resolveeveryticket缺scope/resolved定义/系统authority/财务影响/latency/approval/真正业务目标，技术选型前明确责任。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## The Concept
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 先decision需求和当前baseline，再衡量capability/value/风险/nongoal不同对象。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Start With the Decision, Not the Feature
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: observableoutcome/owner/downstreamaction/errorcost/hardconstraint定义，不BuildClaudeAgentfeature先。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Classify Requirements Before Prioritizing Them
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: functional/quality/performance/security/safety/operability/lifecycle7类暴露矛盾，quality98%和p95/rps只是任务示例。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Map the Current Workflow
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 真实workflow每stepinputoutput/record/role/rule/异常/delay/data/evidence，非idealdiagram，不默认adaptiveagent。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Separate Value From Capability
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: draft能力只有fullreview/rework后businessimprovement才价值，baseline-target-guardrail/window每项evidence或assumption。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Turn Risk Into a Review Boundary
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: impact/reversible/evidence/policy/abuse/reviewcost决定具体trigger/person/packet/time/fallback，人审不是通用免费保险。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Define SLI, SLO, and SLA Correctly
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: SLI测信号/SLO内部目标/SLA定义后果承诺，qualitypopulation/label/窗口/evaluator缺一不许泛95%准确保证。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Make Non-Goals Explicit
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 明确不send/notclose/notexecute/语言pilot边界防scope漂移，disagreement要owner裁决，不偷偷延期。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Build It
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: Build空；真正brief/assumptionaudit/costerror表和ADR在Capstone/Use，main只文字checker。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Interactive Lab
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 实际22图businessimpact/reliabilitydemand两slider3choice，非baseline/target/reviewcost/quality/latency/硬authority真实约束模拟。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Practice Lab
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: unsupportedbaseline应转assumption、补owner/evidence/decisiondate，程序只词不存在不检测statementunsupported。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Shipped Artifact
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 填brief称approved但无签批/source证明，11min→3/6week/98%等只是scenario，不用户承诺。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Verify It
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 6tests检查requiredheads/baseline-target/sli-slo/assumption/nongoal词，无fact/estimate/preference/constraint逐stmt分类。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Capstone Connection
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: professionalcapstone第一artifact候选；onepage模板与审fact/estimate/preference/constraints证据只开放设计，未实际approval。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Prioritize With Cost of Error
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: errorcost维度wrongimpact/reversible/sensitivity/action/evidence高改变架构边界而非自动禁AI，硬规则不能交易。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Use It
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 三candidateRAGdraft/knownworkflow/adaptiveagent按需求比较，ADR存context/options/why/rejected/consequences/verification可审并复议。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Exam Decision Patterns
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: broadrequest先baseline/authority/value/riskiestassumptionpilot，不最大model/框架数先。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Common Traps
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 四trapagentforall/reviewfree/accuracy无N/noowner，性能和价值假设需定量且全失败分母。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Turning Every Request Into an Agent
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: adaptiveflex带调用/attack/testing/tail成本，path变化真正需求才能用agent。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Treating Human Review as Free
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: reviewqueue可新瓶颈，时间/一致性/升级质量需要实测不忽略费用。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Using Accuracy Without a Denominator
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: accuracy指明dataset/population/gold/evaluator/window和unknown，不拿裸数部署。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Ignoring Ownership After Launch

quiz.title: Business Discovery, Requirements, and SLAs

questions.question: A stakeholder asks for an autonomous support agent. What should the architect establish first?
options: The number of specialist subagents and the handoff protocol between them
The orchestration framework, hosting topology, and preferred deployment region
The model family, context window, and token budget that fit the expected support volume
The business outcome, baseline, authority boundary, and cost of error
questions.explanation: Discovery must define the decision, desired outcome, current baseline, authority, and consequences before a technical pattern can be evaluated. Model and framework choices follow those requirements.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D：outcome/baseline/actionauthority/errorcost先于agent人数/框架/型号，利用现资料不问冗余问题，缺真正目标边界才澄清。

questions.question: Which statement is a service-level indicator rather than an objective or agreement?
options: The percentage of evaluated drafts with a valid active-policy citation
The team will approve launch only if citation quality improves during the pilot
Eligible customers receive a first response within the contracted four-hour window
At least 98 percent of drafts should cite the active policy
questions.explanation: An SLI is the measured signal. The 98 percent target is an SLO, while the contractual response promise is an SLA. Choosing a tool is neither.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A：比例signal是SLI，98%target SLO，具体contractwindow SLA；分母样本/activepolicy/span支持定义仍须冻结。

questions.question: A proposed workflow automates refund execution, but policy requires approval above a threshold. Which requirement class makes the architecture conflict explicit?
options: Service-level performance requirement
Safety and authority requirement
Model quality and evaluation requirement
Functional automation requirement
questions.explanation: The approval threshold limits action authority and prevents a high-impact outcome. It is a safety and authorization constraint, not a presentation or model preference.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B：refund批准阈值是safety/authorityhardconstraint，自动executefunctional愿望不能抵消，不按性能指标交易许可。

questions.question: Why should a pilot measure human review time as well as model quality?
options: Review time proves whether the approval policy must cover every generated draft
Review time determines the context size and model tier needed for each request
Human review can move the bottleneck instead of reducing total work
Review time directly measures model quality
questions.explanation: A system can generate good drafts yet fail the business goal if review cost erases the time saved. Human review is an operational step with latency, capacity, and quality of its own.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C：review能新瓶颈，qualitygood也未fullvalue改善；measurequeue/time/人审错误/acceptedcost，而非审时间直接等modelquality。

questions.question: A stable claims workflow has known steps and strict latency targets. Which starting architecture is most defensible?
options: A single Claude call with structured output and validation after every completed claim
A bounded agent that selects the next step dynamically within explicit tool limits
A planner-executor pair with bounded handoffs
A deterministic workflow with Claude used only where judgment is required
questions.explanation: Known steps and strict latency favor deterministic orchestration. Claude can handle bounded judgment tasks while the workflow keeps sequence, permissions, and failure handling explicit.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D：已知步骤+strictlatency由deterministicorchestration只在必要judgment用LM，agent不是更成熟必须步骤。

questions.question: What makes an architecture decision record useful during later review?
options: It records context, alternatives, the decision, consequences, and verification plan
It records the final component diagram and deployment owner
It stores the operational metrics, alerts, and traces needed to verify the architecture
It freezes the original rationale so later maintainers cannot reverse the approved design
questions.explanation: An ADR preserves why the choice fit the evidence and constraints at the time, including rejected alternatives and consequences. That context makes future reversal or revision rational.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A：ADR存当时context/options/decision/consequence/verification使后续合理改，非永久禁止撤销或单diagramowner就完整。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Learning Objectives

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Choose the Smallest Pattern That Fits

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Augmented Model Call

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Deterministic Workflow

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Multi-Agent System

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Decompose Around Contracts

quiz.title: End-to-End Architecture and Value Tradeoffs

questions.question: A process has stable, known steps and strict audit requirements. Which pattern is the strongest default?
options: A tool-enabled single prompt
A planner-executor agent pair
A deterministic workflow
A bounded agent
questions.explanation: Known steps and audit needs favor code-owned transitions, narrow permissions, and explicit recovery. An agent is justified only when adaptive path selection is a real requirement.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C：knownsteps/auditfavorcodeownedworkflowstate/recovery，adaptive设计须实际需求证据而非更多modeltools。

questions.question: When is a multi-agent design most justified?
options: When redundant agents independently vote on every output
When an agent framework supports handoffs and parallel execution without additional application code
When a task has distinct stages that can each receive a specialized prompt and dedicated tool set
When context isolation, independent review, or parallel work measurably improves the outcome
questions.explanation: Multiple agents add coordination, cost, and handoff risk. They earn that complexity when isolation, independence, parallelism, or specialization addresses a measured requirement.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D：isolation/independentreview/trueparallel有测量收益才justify多agent，不每stage都agent/冗余投票自动可靠，本项目delegate还依当前授权。

questions.question: Which control should be enforced outside the model?
options: Whether a requested refund exceeds the caller's authorized limit
Whether a clause creates material business risk under the available evidence
Whether a summary preserves the decision-critical nuance of the source material
Whether a draft is sufficiently persuasive
questions.explanation: An authorization limit is a stable predicate over trusted identity and transaction data. Code must enforce it. Semantic judgments can use Claude with evaluation and review.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A：trustedprincipal/amount/limit的确定predicate外层enforce，modelproposal/typedJSON不permission；语义claim另模型/qualifiedreview。

questions.question: Why can the cheapest model per token be more expensive per successful task?
options: Low unit price always lowers task cost
Higher retry and human-review rates can outweigh the lower call price
Its token price changes the authorization boundary for costly or high-impact tool calls
Its lower capability tier requires every tool operation to be confirmed by a human reviewer
questions.explanation: Architecture economics include retries, tool calls, review labor, and corrections. Lower unit price does not guarantee lower expected cost for an accepted outcome.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B：便宜unitprice可更多calls/retries/tool/humanrework，fullacceptedcost分母/费用单位与未知保留，不当某现型号结论。

questions.question: A contract pipeline returns polished redlines with unsupported conclusions. Which change best addresses the structural failure?
options: Retrieve the highest-ranked clauses, generate the full redline in one step, and keep the version with the strongest confidence score
Run a second verifier prompt over each completed redline and accept it when the verifier reports no unsupported claims
Separate retrieval, clause analysis, evidence review, redline generation, and approval with explicit contracts
Add the full contract and policy library to one longer prompt, then require citations in the returned redline
questions.explanation: The failure comes from collapsed responsibilities and missing provenance. Decomposition with contracts localizes errors and prevents generation from bypassing evidence review.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C：versionedretrieval/analysis/evidencegate/redline/approval拆契约，流畅secondselfreview/更多文本或confidence不真实支持结论。

questions.question: What should a feedback record include so it can guide an architecture change?
options: The final answer, its cited evidence, and the model confidence reported for each conclusion
A task-level rating, reviewer identity, and timestamp attached to the final response
Token usage, latency, retry count, and total cost for the completed model trajectory
Input class, versions, evidence, trajectory, validation, human edits, and downstream outcome
questions.explanation: A useful feedback loop connects outcome to the system state and trajectory that produced it. That evidence distinguishes prompt, retrieval, tool, routing, and scope failures.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D：feedbackinputclasses+versions/source+trajectory/checks/humancorrection+outcome可归因，onlyconfidence/timing/rating不足定位boundary。

成本公式modelcalls字面count与其它cost混单位需明确转换，actualreceipt费用已含retry时不能又加double；源码没有cost计算。

lessons.title: RAG, Retrieval, and Data Pipelines

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Learning Objectives
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: ingest-chunk-index-query-ACL-generate-claim边界、5retrievaltypes、检索-vsanswer评测与fresh/provenance，目标非模型生成全部真实。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## The Problem
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 文档更新后oldthreshold在topcandidate，promptlatest无效因索引/metadata错；先找earliestdataboundary不猜modelregression。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## The Concept
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: RAG数据系统和生成系统不同N/错误，context不是authority自动。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### RAG Is a Data System
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: sources normalize/chunk+meta/index+version→identityfilter/rank/context→generatecitation/claimvalidate/outcomeeval，各stage独立失败。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Design Chunks Around Meaning and Retrieval
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: chunk按可引用meaning/APImethod/tableheader/ticketcontext/code符号，wordwindow是baseline，overlap重复及空间crowding须测。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Match Retrieval to Query and Data Shape
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: sparse/dense/hybrid/filtered/iterative按query/data/ACL/pathneed，不相关score当事实。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Sparse Retrieval
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: BM25式lexical适合exactcode/identifier且需具体tokenization，源码ASCII与复数未lemmatize。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Dense Retrieval
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: embeddingsemanticparaphrase相关不authoritative或identifierexact，当前模型向量未run。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Hybrid Retrieval
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 候选fusion/rerank混lexical-semantic为策略，source实现并无dense/hybrid实际比较。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Filtered Retrieval
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 可信permission/tenant/date在进入model前过滤，文字ignoreforbidden太晚；源class缺ACL/jurisdiction字段。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: #### Iterative Retrieval
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: adaptivequeryref/reformulate仅发现必要时，有queryturntimecost预算，source当前不agent调用。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Separate Retrieval Evaluation From Answer Evaluation
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: Recall/P@k/MRR/nDCG/fresh/leak检索层与support/citation/coverage/abstain/conflict生成层分开。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Preserve Provenance as Data
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: ID/chunk/version/date/原span/rank/transform与claim保持，source真实记录不是后生成引用。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Make Refresh Atomic and Observable
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: newversionvalidated→atomicpointer/rollback、lag/count/index/embed/empty/rankdistribution观察，activeflag只是教学子门。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Build It
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: Build空；真正stdlib BM25实验6steps在Capstone，源码submodule确实现有限chunk/rankmetrics但不完整RAG。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Interactive Lab
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 24动态图仅relevance/coverage人为55/45阈，没lexicaldocument/topK/filters/IDs/真实metric。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Practice Lab
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 加入inactive确能flag排除，unauthorized却无字段/handler须先实现；本轮只静读不program运行。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Shipped Artifact
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: report是filled1rank+2syntheticactive/inactive与1.0指标，freshgate人工标记不真currentpolicy或authority证明。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Verify It
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 8test静读ASCII/overlap/flag/rank/empty/topk/metric，未对shippedreport作demoJSONfullroundtrip。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Capstone Connection
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: stdlibcase展示BM25透明TF/DF/length/IDF和2query，不能称生产搜索更准/时效ACL或semantic生成复现。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Step 1: Normalize Tokens
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: tokenize ASCIIregexlower，与wordwindow分词不一致，中文/Unicode要另policy并核数字单位。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Step 2: Chunk With Stable Identity
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: chunkID docid:position+date/wordwindow，不绑定contentSHA/精确原offset/parentheading，更新同docid会复用identity。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Step 3: Exclude Inactive Sources Before Indexing
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: build仅truthyactiveflag过滤，不根据approvedversion/effective/permission/currentdate计算，原inactivefixture可核。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Step 4: Score Transparently
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: score TF饱和k1=1.5、b=.75按平均chunktokenlength和IDF(log(1+(N−df+.5)/(df+.5)))，N/df是chunks不是原docs。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Step 5: Return Provenance
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: hit存doc/chunk/date/text/roundscore，但无sourceURI/scope/parser/tokenizer版本/真正semanticspan，generator未实现。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Step 6: Evaluate the Retriever
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: evaluate按gold docID集合计算每queryrecall与firstchunkrankMRR，chunkduplicate消耗topK；空goldrecall1/emptycases0需unknown适用处理。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Use It
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 排data earliestquery→activeversion→parseexception→ACL→strategy→sameeval→atomicrefresh→claimsupport，源码只rank需要完整主干接线。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Exam Decision Patterns
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 更新后wrong先source/indexfilter不是temperature；similarity/引用本体不能补authority。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Common Traps
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: fourtrapcapacity-grounding/simauthority/citation-support/appendrefresh各需独立provenance/versions/checks。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### More Context Means More Grounding
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 大量irrelevanttext挤有效evidence，更大payload非自动grounding。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Similar Means Authoritative
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: score和date不提供precedence/tenantpermission，metadata治理不是语言模型决定。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Valid Citation Means Supported Claim
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: citation可真而claim超span，supportcoverage需人工/校judge核，代码没answer层。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Refresh Means Append
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: append新旧source会冲突，versionedswitch才能真实同配置回滚，不是sourceactiveflag配置就实现atomic。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Exercises
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 5练习titleboost/jurisdictionACL/hybridfusion/10cases/atomicrefresh需实际协议与负例，未改源或run。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Key Terms
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: chunk/sparse/dense/hybrid/recall/provenance词义与指标分母不同，retrievalrecall不是answeraccuracy。

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ## Further Reading
outside_fence_h2_h4.chinese_learning_meaning: 当前citations/token-counting API/modelvector/index版本未核，stable方法与现RAG/语言主干去重。

quiz.title: RAG, Retrieval, and Data Pipelines

questions.question: A RAG system becomes confidently wrong immediately after a document refresh while the model and latency are unchanged. What should be investigated first?
options: Ingestion, index versions, filters, and retrieved chunks
An output-formatting rule that may suppress qualifying language from otherwise grounded answers
A temperature setting that now makes generation less deterministic for the refreshed documents
A model-weight regression near the refresh
questions.explanation: The timing points to the data and retrieval boundary. Inspect active source versions, parsing, chunking, filters, and candidate ranking before changing the model.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A：refresh前后source/indexversion/filter/hitIDs最直接证据，timing只是诊断线索不严格因果证明，先复现earliestfault。

questions.question: Which retrieval method is especially useful for exact error codes and product identifiers?
options: Dense semantic retrieval
Sparse term-based retrieval
Generative query expansion
Cross-encoder reranking
questions.explanation: Sparse retrieval preserves exact lexical matches and is strong for codes, names, and policy phrases. Dense retrieval can complement it for paraphrases.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B：exactcodes/names稀疏lexical适合baseline，dense/rerank可补semantic；ASCII源tokenizer不能泛中文或所有ID。

questions.question: Why must access-control filtering happen before retrieved text reaches Claude?
options: Post-generation filtering enforces the same boundary
Filtering before context preserves the retriever's original relevance order across users with different permissions
Prompt instructions are not an authorization boundary
Access-control metadata is unavailable to Claude once a retriever serializes document chunks into prompt text
questions.explanation: Forbidden content should never enter model context. A request to ignore unauthorized text does not enforce confidentiality or least privilege.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C：authfilterbeforemodelboundary，promptignore/后输出过滤不能收回已经向model泄露data，trustedactor判资源scope。

questions.question: What does recall at K measure in a retrieval evaluation?
options: What fraction of the top K candidates is labeled relevant to the evaluation query
What fraction of cited source URLs remain reachable when the evaluation is replayed
Whether the answer cites all K candidates
Whether required evidence appears among the top K candidates
questions.explanation: Recall at K measures candidate coverage for labeled relevant evidence. It isolates retrieval quality before generation is evaluated.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D：requiredgoldcoverage amongtopK按相关集定义Recall，单gold是hit，notP@K/URLreachable/answercitation数量；标无gold任务不套空集fullrecall。

questions.question: Two active policy chunks conflict. What is the most reliable system behavior?
options: Apply an explicit precedence rule if one exists; otherwise report the conflict and escalate
Prefer the chunk from the most recently refreshed index because freshness establishes policy authority
Ask the model to reconcile both chunks into one conservative rule and flag its answer as low confidence
Use the chunk with the highest semantic score, then cite the lower-ranked chunk as supplementary context
questions.explanation: Similarity does not establish authority. The system needs a trusted precedence rule or an explicit conflict result that routes to a qualified owner.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A：有approvedprecedence就按规则，不明则冲突+owner，不让新date或更高score造authority。

questions.question: Which refresh design best prevents old and new chunks from mixing in production?
options: Clear the model and retrieval caches before updating documents in the currently active index
Build and validate a versioned index, then switch the active pointer atomically
Upsert every new chunk into the active index, then delete stale chunks after retrieval smoke tests pass
Increase overlap between refreshed chunks so both old and new policy wording remain retrievable during rollout
questions.explanation: A versioned build plus validation and atomic activation keeps the serving index consistent and retains a rollback path if retrieval quality regresses.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B：validatednewindex+atomicpointer/retainedrollback避免mixedversions，sourcebuildactive只是简化fixture，无生产alias或cachecoord。

lessons.title: Integration Protocols, Identity, and Least Privilege

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Choose an Integration Shape From the Boundary
### Propagate Identity, Do Not Replace It
### Use Least Privilege at Four Levels
### MCP Scopes Do Not Define Business Authorization
### Step 2: Define Principal and Tool Contracts
### One Service Account for Every User

quiz.title: Integration Protocols, Identity, and Least Privilege

questions.question: Support staff only read tickets and draft replies, but their agent also has refund and account-deletion tools. What best reduces risk?
options: Route sensitive tool calls to a larger model that can reason more reliably about authorization
Keep the capabilities visible but require each tool description to repeat the role's policy limits
Remove the unnecessary tools and scopes from that role
Keep every tool but log sensitive calls
questions.explanation: Least privilege removes capabilities the role does not need. Logging and warnings can support controls but leave the unnecessary authority and attack surface intact.

questions.question: Why are capability discovery and execution authorization separate controls?
options: Discovery is evaluated when a session begins, so authorization is only required for tools reached outside the advertised catalog
Discovery limits context, so execution authorization is redundant
Discovery filters capabilities at the host, while the integration protocol automatically authorizes every advertised operation
Hiding tools reduces exposure, while execution authorization prevents direct or stale unauthorized calls
questions.explanation: A narrow catalog improves selection and exposure, but a caller may still reach an endpoint or permissions may change. The service must authorize every execution.

questions.question: When is MCP a stronger fit than a direct API?
options: When multiple hosts need standardized dynamic discovery of capabilities across server boundaries
When one stable service needs the lowest latency
When an integration needs the protocol layer to infer user identity and grant permissions without a separate policy service
When any Claude application needs tool calls and wants one protocol to replace service-specific authorization
questions.explanation: MCP earns its extra boundary through standardized capability discovery and integration across hosts. A known low-overhead service call may remain clearer as a direct API.

questions.question: What must a reliable approval bind to?
options: The model's confidence, risk classification, and stated reason for selecting the proposed capability
Exact action, parameters, requester, approver authority, and expiration
The tool name and approving tenant
The current prompt and conversation identifier so all tool calls within that model turn inherit approval
questions.explanation: Approval is valid for a specific proposed effect under a specific identity and time window. Changed parameters require a new decision.

questions.question: A tool returns an authorization error. How should an agent harness classify it?
options: Route the request to a stronger model so it can revise the tool parameters until authorization succeeds
Retry with the same credentials after exponential backoff because authorization services can be temporarily inconsistent
Non-retryable unless access or approval state changes, with a safe escalation action
Record the failure as a tool warning, omit the restricted effect, and continue as though the workflow succeeded
questions.explanation: Repeating the same unauthorized request cannot succeed. A structured error should explain the safe next step without leaking secret details.

questions.question: Why is an application-wide service API key insufficient for per-user authorization?
options: It prevents downstream audit logs from recording the application identity or the requested service operation
It authenticates only the client transport and therefore cannot invoke downstream service endpoints directly
It expires at application scope, so a user request can outlive the credential before authorization is checked
It identifies broad application authority but may not carry the human principal, tenant, or current scopes
questions.explanation: The downstream service needs trusted claims about the actual principal and requested action. Broad application credentials can collapse user boundaries into unenforceable prompt instructions.

lessons.title: Production Observability, Latency, and Cost

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Logs, Metrics, and Traces Have Different Jobs
### Separate System Success From Task Success
### Use Rollouts to Limit Evidence Risk

quiz.title: Production Observability, Latency, and Cost

questions.question: A dashboard shows 99.9 percent successful API calls, but users report wrong answers. What is missing?
options: A lower generation temperature recorded as an attribute on every successful model span
Task-quality and trajectory evaluation connected to system traces
A larger model for semantic errors
A transport retry metric that separates transient HTTP failures from successful first-attempt requests
questions.explanation: Transport success only proves the protocol completed. The system needs evidence about retrieval, tools, validation, final-state quality, and downstream outcomes.

questions.question: Why should a team monitor P95 latency as well as P50?
options: P95 combines response time and model accuracy so a team can detect quality degradation in slow requests
P95 approximates the slowest request
P95 exposes slow paths such as retries, large contexts, and tool timeouts that the median hides
P50 is unstable at production traffic volumes, while P95 remains comparable across any sample size
questions.explanation: The median describes the ordinary path. Tail percentiles reveal a slower cohort that can dominate user complaints and timeout behavior.

questions.question: Which cost comparison best supports model routing decisions?
options: The average provider charge per model call, including cached and uncached input tokens
The monthly application infrastructure spend allocated across all attempted tasks, regardless of acceptance
The output-token price for each model multiplied by the median completion length
Total model, tool, retry, review, and correction cost per accepted task outcome
questions.explanation: A cheaper call can create more retries and review. Cost per successful outcome incorporates the full trajectory and enables a fair architecture comparison.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of a distributed trace in a Claude application?
options: Connect model, retrieval, tool, validation, retry, and approval spans for one trajectory
Store complete user inputs and credentials so every production failure can be reproduced from one record
Guarantee task correctness by proving that every required model, retrieval, and tool span completed successfully
Replace aggregate service metrics
questions.explanation: A trace reveals where time and failure occurred across the end-to-end path. Metrics aggregate behavior, while evaluations determine correctness.

questions.question: After a release, P95 latency and cost rise while P50 stays stable. Which investigation is most useful?
options: Treat the stable median as evidence that the release is healthy and wait for the tail to converge with more traffic
Inspect slow-path retries, rate limits, large inputs, tool timeouts, and cache misses by release version
Disable detailed tracing because added span collection is the most likely cause of the higher cost and tail latency
Shorten all prompts with higher median token use
questions.explanation: The shape points to a slow cohort rather than a universal slowdown. Versioned traces and strata can identify retries, tools, input size, and cache behavior in that cohort.

questions.question: Which rollout policy is strongest for a new architecture variant?
options: Canary the variant while monitoring transport errors and latency, then evaluate task quality after reaching full traffic
Route all low-risk traffic to the cheapest variant first, then add quality evaluation if user complaints increase
Shadow, canary, guarded expansion, and automatic rollback using quality, safety, latency, and cost gates
Release to all users after the offline suite and one production demo pass, then compare aggregate metrics with the prior release
questions.explanation: Progressive exposure limits harm while collecting live evidence. Multiple gates prevent an economic improvement from hiding quality or safety regression.

lessons.title: Enterprise Governance, Compliance, and Human Review

outside_fence_h2_h4.heading: ### Map Data Through the Whole System
### Design Human Review as a Control
### Treat Fairness as a Contextual Requirement

quiz.title: Enterprise Governance, Compliance, and Human Review

questions.question: A team says a sensitive-data workflow is compliant because every output receives human review. What is the main problem with that claim?
options: The only missing evidence is a benchmark proving reviewers outperform the model on average cases
The review stage should be replaced by a second model because automated consistency is easier to audit than reviewer judgment
Compliance follows from an enterprise plan and encrypted transport, so the team only needs to document those product settings
It omits the data flow, feature configuration, reviewer design, control evidence, and authorized compliance decision
questions.explanation: Review is one possible control. Governance requires the exact data boundary, obligations, technical controls, owners, tests, residual risk, and decisions by qualified authorities.

questions.question: Which action follows data minimization?
options: Remove identity fields that the task does not require before sending data
Pseudonymize identifiers after the provider response while leaving the original request payload unchanged
Log every input field, encrypted, for future incident reconstruction
Send every available field but instruct the model to ignore attributes unrelated to the current task
questions.explanation: Minimization prevents unnecessary data from entering the system. Encryption and access controls then protect the data that remains necessary.

questions.question: What makes human review a real control?
options: Two reviewers approve every output, regardless of risk, evidence quality, queue capacity, authority, or reversibility
A defined trigger, qualified reviewer, evidence packet, authority, service level, fallback, and audit record
Use model confidence alone to route low-scoring outputs to an available reviewer
Every output enters a general review queue, where any available reviewer chooses what evidence and escalation are needed
questions.explanation: Review reduces risk only when the person can detect and act on the failure within an operationally viable process. The design must specify each boundary.

questions.question: Why should an architect verify retention for each enabled feature?
options: Feature retention determines model accuracy and context capacity even when the deployed data path remains unchanged
Prompt wording selects the provider retention tier, and each feature accepts a different retention instruction
Files, batch, hosted sessions, tools, and standard requests can cross different storage and eligibility boundaries
All hosted features inherit one retention policy, so the team must verify that shared policy only once for the account
questions.explanation: The concrete data flow depends on the features and agreement in use. Governance must evaluate the deployed combination against current official documentation.

questions.question: A high-impact workflow has an aggregate quality gain but a large regression for one affected group. What is the strongest response?
options: Replace the group slice with a larger overall sample and apply the same aggregate threshold to every future release
Route the affected group to a larger model while keeping the rollout open, since model capacity is the most likely cause
Deploy the aggregate improvement, monitor the affected group in production, and wait for a larger sample before deciding on a separate control later
Investigate the slice, assess harm and uncertainty, involve the proper owner, and block or constrain rollout until the risk decision is made
questions.explanation: Aggregate performance cannot average away a material group harm. The team needs contextual fairness analysis, evidence, authority, and a controlled deployment decision.

questions.question: Which event should trigger governance reassessment?
options: A material change to use case, model, data, tool authority, scale, policy, or observed risk
Any documentation-format change, because every editorial revision invalidates the architecture's approval boundary
Wait for the annual governance review unless a highest-severity production incident occurs
Only a change to the base model, because prompts, data, tools, scale, and policy do not alter approved risk
questions.explanation: Approval applies to a specific architecture and risk profile. Material changes can alter affected people, data boundaries, controls, and residual risk, so the decision must be revisited.

quiz.title: Stakeholder Communication, ADRs, and Lifecycle Ownership

questions.question: An executive review receives only a detailed component diagram. What critical information is missing?
options: A dependency inventory showing whether the proposed design is technically feasible
A model benchmark and prompt transcript so the group can compare raw answer quality before discussing ownership
The business decision, options, consequences, residual risk, evidence, and owner
A line-by-line implementation plan so executives can estimate engineering effort without the delivery team's input
questions.explanation: Executives need to decide whether expected value justifies investment and residual risk. Components matter only as evidence for that decision.

questions.question: Why should an ADR include rejected alternatives?
options: To make every considered option appear equally credible
To stop future teams revisiting the decision after constraints change
To replace implementation tests with the written decision record
To preserve which constraints and evidence made other choices weaker
questions.explanation: Rejected options preserve tradeoff context. Future teams can revisit the decision rationally when evidence or constraints change instead of repeating hidden analysis.

questions.question: When is an operational handoff complete?
options: When the receiving owners can monitor, evaluate, recover, change, and support the system under agreed acceptance criteria
When the implementation team stays on call indefinitely, so the receiving team never needs independent recovery or change capability
When the deck, runbook, and repository have been delivered, even if receiving owners have not exercised them
When one production request succeeds and the implementation team has documented the nominal workflow
questions.explanation: Handoff transfers demonstrated operating ability and responsibility. Dashboards, runbooks, evaluation, rollback, access, review capacity, and ownership must be ready.

questions.question: What is the strongest way to assign lifecycle ownership?
options: Wait until the first incident reveals which team has the operational access and expertise to respond
Name owners and approvers for each decision, artifact, control, metric, and operational response
Give one AI team end-to-end ownership so fewer groups must coordinate lifecycle decisions
Assign ownership to the model-routing service so changes to prompts, knowledge, controls, and policy stay synchronized
questions.explanation: Specific assets and decisions change at different rates and require different authority. Concrete ownership prevents silent decay and unclear escalation.

questions.question: A pilot has high login counts but reviewer time and correction rate doubled. What should the steering group conclude?
options: Expand the pilot immediately so a larger user sample can determine whether the correction rate is statistically stable
Treat the login growth as proof of adoption because reviewer effort is an implementation cost that should fall after scale
Usage alone is insufficient; evaluate outcome, rework, review burden, quality, and cost per accepted result
Exclude reviewer time from the scorecard because human correction sits outside measured AI performance
questions.explanation: The workflow may have shifted work instead of reducing it. Adoption must connect to the intended business and quality outcomes without hidden operational burden.

questions.question: What is a useful reversal condition in an architecture decision?
options: A scheduled date when the team must reconsider the decision, regardless of whether any relevant evidence has changed
A general quality-improvement goal used as the condition that triggers future architecture reconsideration
Any stakeholder question about the architecture, even when the question does not challenge a constraint or outcome
A measurable event, such as P95 latency or review load exceeding an agreed bound, that triggers reconsideration
questions.explanation: A reversal condition turns uncertainty into a planned response. It identifies evidence that invalidates the current tradeoff and prompts a controlled decision review.

quiz.title: Ship a Week of Work, Not a Perfect Prompt

questions.question: What is the central capstone deliverable?
options: A polished prompt that drafts the weekly brief directly from the approved source archive
A memorized comparison of models, context limits, product surfaces, and feature availability
An automatic publication service that removes human approval from the recurring reporting process
A governed decision workflow with sources, validation, authority, handoff, and recovery
questions.explanation: The capstone integrates the full Associate skill set around an observable, reviewable workflow.

questions.question: Why freeze a weekly source snapshot?
options: To ensure generation and review refer to the same versioned evidence boundary
To remove the need for source ownership because versioning establishes authority automatically
To replace claim citations with one link to the weekly archive
To guarantee that each source remains permanently correct after the documented cutoff time
questions.explanation: A snapshot makes the run reproducible and exposes changes that require a separate delta review.

questions.question: Which capstone property belongs in deterministic Python validation?
options: Whether leadership prefers the brief's tone, framing, and level of detail
Whether every claim's source ID exists in the versioned registry used for the run
Whether the assigned reviewer has enough competence and decision authority
Whether the source policies produce ethically sufficient outcomes for affected people
questions.explanation: Referential integrity is exact and repeatable. Ethical sufficiency and reviewer qualification require organizational judgment.

questions.question: A signed source changes after the director approves the brief. What should happen?
options: Ask the model to ignore the changed fields so the approved draft remains reproducible against its prior prompt
Publish the approved brief and record the source change for the next weekly reporting cycle
Invalidate the publication gate, compare the new source with the approved snapshot, and review the delta
Delete the earlier snapshot and rebuild the source registry so reviewers see only the latest evidence
questions.explanation: Approval applies to a particular evidence snapshot. A material change must be evaluated before release.

questions.question: The workflow repeatedly misses one regional exception. What is the strongest response?
options: Pause the region until its inputs match the standard reporting format used elsewhere
Strengthen confidence wording so reviewers can distinguish conclusions from regional exceptions
Continue correcting the regional exception manually during every weekly human review
Add the failure to the evaluation set and repair source, prompt, or coverage controls
questions.explanation: A durable case and system repair close the learning loop and prevent recurrence.

questions.question: When is the capstone ready for a limited release?
options: After normal and failure tests pass, blockers are resolved, human authority and fallback work, and current product facts are verified
When every workflow stage is automated, input variation has been eliminated, and the release no longer depends on human intervention
After one end-to-end demonstration passes and the team records every remaining defect for monitoring during the pilot
When the highest-capability model is selected and its benchmark results exceed the baseline for the average workflow case
questions.explanation: Readiness is evidence across quality, governance, operations, recovery, and current product configuration.
